request.system: You are a strict claim verifier. You only trust the catalog facts given to you.
request.user:
Verify every factual claim in the campaign is grounded in the catalog facts. Fail if any claim is unsupported, exaggerated, or contradicts the facts.
Rules (from reviewer overrides):
- ANY mention of an out-of-stock product (stock 0) fails, whether or not the copy prompts purchase — no editorial exception.
- Numeric spec claims (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) must match the catalog exactly; doubling or inflating a spec fails.
- Transferring an attribute from another product, or upgrading 'water-resistant' to 'waterproof', is a fabricated claim and fails.
- A comparative or superlative claim ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', 'most X') is scoped to the product type named in the claim and checked against the comparison set below: it fails if a same-type peer beats the subject on the compared attribute. Vague puffery ('great gear', 'toughest', 'best ever') with no measurable attribute is acceptable.
Catalog facts:
NB-JKT-07 Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket: attributes={'layers': 3, 'waterproof_rating_mm': 20000, 'breathability_gm2': 20000, 'weight_grams': 420, 'material': '3-layer laminate'} stock=12

Claims to verify:
- Waterproof rating: 20,000 mm
- Breathability: 20,000 g/m²
- 3-layer laminate construction for sustained wet weather
- Weight: 420 g

Body: You know how fast a good shell sells out. The Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket (NB-JKT-07) is restocked — for now.

If you've got a wet-weather trip on the calendar, here's what matters:

• 20,000 mm waterproof rating — keeps rain out during sustained downpours
• 20,000 g/m² breathability — moves sweat out during high-output climbs
• 3-layer laminate construction — holds up through extended wet weather, not just a quick shower
• 420 g — light enough to earn its place in your pack

This is a shell jacket, built for rain management on trail. It's not insulated and not designed as a standalone layer in cold-static conditions.

Stock has moved quickly with each restock. If the Stormline is on your list, now's the time to check sizing.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.

response:
```json
{
  "reasoning": "All numeric specifications (20,000 mm waterproof rating, 20,000 g/m² breathability, 420 g weight) match catalog facts exactly; the 3-layer laminate material attribute is confirmed; the product is in stock (12 units); no comparative/superlative claims are made; no out-of-stock products are mentioned; descriptive language about performance is appropriate puffery tied to verified specs.",
  "evidence": [
    "Catalog waterproof_rating_mm: 20000 matches claim '20,000 mm waterproof rating'",
    "Catalog breathability_gm2: 20000 matches claim '20,000 g/m² breathability'",
    "Catalog weight_grams: 420 matches claim '420 g'",
    "Catalog material: '3-layer laminate' matches claim '3-layer laminate construction'",
    "Catalog stock=12, not 0; product is in stock",
    "No comparative claims ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', etc.) made",
    "Descriptive claims ('keeps rain out', 'moves sweat out', 'light enough') are performance descriptions tied to verified specs, not fabricated attributes"
  ],
  "score": 1.0,
  "verdict": "pass"
}
```
